title: Maguindanao del Sur civilians urged to back loose firearms drive

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The military has encouraged the public in Maguindanao del Sur to continue supporting the government’s campaign against loose firearms, with civilians surrendering at least 34 unlicensed guns anew in the province. Lt. Col. Loqui Marco, commander of the 90th Infantry Battalion, facilitated the surrender and turnover on Wednesday of the firearms to Brig. Gen. Gremel Brual, commander of the 601st Infantry Brigade, at the battalion headquarters in Datu Saudi Ampatuan town. Brual lauded the local government leaders and other stakeholders for their continued support for the government’s campaign against illegal firearms.
